## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed. Use synthetic examples only. Do not attach real incident data, credentials, or personal data.

## Security and compatibility

Describe changes to policy, signed data formats, key handling, connector permissions, or platform behavior. State explicitly when none apply.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran, with results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has an author-matching DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; I added meaningful coverage for behavior changes.
- [ ] English documentation is updated, with Spanish user-guide translations where applicable.
- [ ] No real incident data, secrets, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Existing signed event identifiers and data formats remain compatible, or the migration is documented.
